# Klavko

> Klavko switches the keyboard layout when you type in the wrong one, fixes typos, and adds voice input, translation, text from the screen and a clipboard history. Free to start, Pro if you want more, and everything stays on your Mac.

Typed a word in the wrong layout? Klavko switches it as you type. It also fixes typos, types what you say, translates and reads text from the screen.

## Facts

- What it is: a typing assistant for Mac that switches the keyboard layout automatically when a word was typed in the wrong one, fixes typos, and adds voice input, translation, text from the screen (OCR) and a clipboard history
- Made by: Stepanix (https://stepanix.com/), which also makes Tapko and Duesko
- Needs: macOS 14 or later. Translation needs macOS 15. Windows 10 and 11 are in beta.
- Price: free with no time limit; Klavko Pro is $9.99 once, not a subscription
- Privacy: Klavko runs entirely on your Mac. What you type and dictate, translations and the clipboard history are never sent anywhere. The internet is needed only to download the speech model and translation languages once, to check GitHub for a new version, and to check the Pro key or trial (only an anonymous code of your Mac is sent, never your text). The one exception is Google AI voice input, if you turn it on yourself.
- Download: https://github.com/stepsergius/Klavko/releases/latest
- Install with Homebrew: brew install --cask stepsergius/klavko/klavko
- Website: https://klavko.stepanix.com/ (English), https://klavko.stepanix.com/uk/ (Ukrainian)
- Community: https://t.me/klavko

## What it does

- Keyboard layout: Switches between the layouts of 13 languages, including Ukrainian, English, German, French, Polish and Turkish. ⇧⇧ switches a word by hand.
- Typos and tidy text: Fixes obvious typos, adds a capital at the start of a sentence, turns ... into … and " into “” or «».
- Voice input: Press fn, speak, press it again: the text appears at the cursor, with punctuation. Recognized on your Mac.
- Translation: Select text anywhere and press ⌘ twice. Return replaces the selection with the translation.
- Text from the screen: Press ⌃Q and select an area: Klavko reads the text, even in a picture, and translates it. QR codes too.
- Clipboard history: ⌥⌘V shows everything you copied: text, links, pictures and files, with search. Passwords are never kept.

## Free edition

- Layout switching in 13 languages
- Typo fixes and tidy text
- Voice input
- Translation and text from the screen
- 7 days of clipboard history
- 14 days of Pro included

## Klavko Pro

- Spelling and grammar check
- Voice input in one language and with translation
- Emoji and calculations at the cursor
- A layout per app, layout keys and key remapping
- Clipboard history beyond 7 days
- More Quick Actions: AI, YouTube, Read Aloud…
- Mac and Windows, up to 2 computers, free updates

## Questions

### Is Klavko safe to install?

Yes. Klavko is signed with its developer's Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple: Apple checks every version for malware before it reaches you. The first time you open it, macOS only asks whether to open an app downloaded from the internet: click Open. Updates install with one click.

### Why does Klavko need Accessibility access?

To see which keys you press and to replace a word typed in the wrong layout, macOS requires the Accessibility permission. Klavko keeps only the text since the last click or Return in memory, and never saves or sends it.

### The layout doesn't switch. Why?

You need at least two keyboard layouts of the supported languages. Standard macOS layouts work best (System Settings → Keyboard → Input Sources). Chinese, Japanese and Korean use input methods and aren't supported.

### Is Klavko free?

Yes. Layout switching, typo fixes, voice input, translation, text from the screen and a week of clipboard history are free for good. Klavko Pro adds more for a one-time $9.99.

### Who gets Pro free?

Everyone who installs Klavko on Mac or Windows before January 1, 2027 gets Pro free for good, with no key. If you already use Klavko, you keep Pro even if you update later. From January 1, 2027, new users get all Pro features for 14 days.

### How do I activate Pro?

After you buy, you get a license key on the order page and by email. Paste it in Klavko → Settings → Klavko Pro and click Activate. The key works on up to 2 computers.

### Can I get a refund?

Yes. If Klavko Pro doesn't work for you, write to stepsergius@gmail.com within 14 days of purchase and you'll get your money back.

### Where do I report a bug or ask a question?

In the Telegram group t.me/klavko. The Windows version is a beta, so reports there help a lot.
